message: Architecture block discovery paused before VHDL generation. The reviewer judged the auto-discovered block contracts as a poor fit.

issues.message: Discovered blocks: fft_lite, spectral_analyzer, pipeline_latency_tracker, output_valid_stage. Missing blocks after review: fir_filter_datapath, multiplier_adder_unit, pipeline_register_stage, spectral_analyzer_math_core, top_level_integration_wrapper, tb_self_checking, constraints_generic, doc_overview, doc_arch_note, doc_unit_notes, doc_verification, ghdl_plan_json. Risks: Reset polarity mismatch: spec requires synchronous active-high, but blocks use active-low rst_ni; Missing arithmetic datapath: no FIR filter, multipliers, or adders discovered; All discovered blocks are identical control FSMs, lacking data path logic; Latency bookkeeping not implemented in discovered blocks; No testbench or constraints provided.
